documents.text: The local CRAG runtime uses qwen2.5:3b for chat generation and nomic-embed-text for embeddings. Qdrant stores the vectors in a collection dedicated to the Ollama embedding model.

The CRAG workflow retrieves internal evidence, grades its relevance with a structured decision, and generates an answer from accepted evidence. When internal evidence is insufficient, it attempts corrective web search; local-only mode reports an explicit web-search configuration error instead of inventing results.

The CRAG API exposes /health/live for application liveness and /health/ready for application and workflow configuration readiness. Evaluation data belongs in a dedicated collection and must not modify production collections.
